question: Should OpenClaw restore `PluginRuntime.channel.turn` as a deprecated compatibility alias, and should that alias be limited to the inbound-shaped helpers in this PR or include the older removed helper names too?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but restoring a deprecated PluginRuntime member is a public plugin API compatibility choice that repository policy says maintainers should own explicitly.

options.title: Accept Narrow Alias After Refresh
options.body: Resolve the current conflicts and land the object-identical `turn === inbound` alias with docs that keep `inbound` canonical for new plugin code.

options.title: Broaden Legacy Helper Scope
options.body: Before merge, also restore or explicitly document the older removed helper names such as `runPrepared`, `runAssembled`, `runResolved`, and `dispatchAssembled`.

options.title: Reject Core Alias
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers decide old channel plugins must republish against `channel.inbound.*` instead of re-expanding core runtime compatibility.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Alias After Refresh
recommendation.body: Resolve the current conflicts and land the object-identical `turn === inbound` alias with docs that keep `inbound` canonical for new plugin code.

likelyOwner.reason: The compatibility decision directly revisits the API removal introduced in steipete's 6c3740255f3a commit.
